Get a job letter from the Ministry of Education Transformation

Last updated on 8 September 2026

Use this service to get an official letter confirming your job, your post and your salary. You can give the letter to a bank, credit union or retailer.

Who can use this service

You can use this service if you currently work for the Ministry of Education Transformation as:

  • a teacher, appointed or with special responsibility
  • permanent or temporary staff of the Ministry
  • ancillary or support staff

If the Ministry has no record for you, or your details have changed recently, contact your school's personnel officer or the Ministry's Personnel Department before you start.

Before you start

You must:

  • be currently employed by the Ministry of Education Transformation
  • request a letter only for yourself

You will need:

  • your name and employee ID, so we can match you to the Ministry's record
  • a work email address on an approved domain, where we will send your letter

When to request a letter

You can request a letter at any time. There is no deadline and no renewal.

Each request creates a new letter, so request one when you need it. The letter shows what the Ministry's record says on the day you request it.

Complete the form

There are 2 ways to get a job letter. You can:

  1. Request a letter online

    Allow about 2 minutes to complete the form.

    Start now
  2. Ask the Personnel Department

    If you cannot use the online service, contact the Ministry's Personnel Department. Contact details are at the bottom of this page.

Cost

There is no cost to request a job letter.

What happens after you request a letter

We email the letter to you as a PDF, usually within a few minutes.

Send or print the letter for your bank, credit union or retailer. Every letter carries a QR code, a reference and a document code, so they can confirm the Ministry issued it and that it has not been altered.

Verification shows what the Ministry's record said on the day the letter was issued. It is not a check of your employment today.

If any detail on your letter is wrong, ask your school's personnel officer or the Ministry's Personnel Department to update your record, then request a new letter.

Contact

If you need help, contact the Personnel Department of the Ministry of Education Transformation.

Telephone: (246) 535-0600
